svg.aria-label: $KVM signal path: a laptop or tablet browser controls an ESP32-S3 over USB serial, Bluetooth or Wi-Fi; the ESP32-S3 acts as USB keyboard, mouse and disk on the target PC; the target's HDMI goes to a USB video capture adapter that feeds the browser.
